# Instruments: Strings

A note's `pitch` uses the **MIDI pitch (60 = middle C)**. Latest list: `muser instruments --family strings`.

| instrument | Recommended range | Polyphony | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `strings.violin` | 55–100 | 8 | Violin (bowed): melody lead |
| `strings.viola` | 48–88 | 8 | Viola (bowed): darker and thicker than the violin |
| `strings.cello` | 36–76 | 8 | Cello (bowed): warm and deep |
| `strings.contrabass` | 28–60 | 8 | Double bass (bowed): the string bass voice |
| `strings.ensemble` | 36–96 | 8 | String ensemble: many players together; suited to chord beds and lyrical passages |
| `strings.violin_pizz` | 55–100 | 8 | Violin pizzicato: short and bouncy |
| `strings.cello_pizz` | 36–76 | 8 | Cello pizzicato |
| `strings.contrabass_pizz` | 28–60 | 8 | Double bass pizzicato: jazz walking bass |

## Adjustable parameters (instrument_params)

Override the sound of the chosen instrument/preset; write only the items you want to change, the rest stay as they are. `muser instruments <name>` shows the preset's current values.

| Parameter | Range | Automation | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attack` | 0.005 – 2 s | next note | Bow attack time. 0.02 forceful; 0.3+ soft fade-in |
| `release` | 0.15 – 10 s | next note | Decay time after release. Minimum 0.15: below that the upstream bowed-string model diverges numerically |
| `vibrato_rate` | 0 – 12 Hz | next note | Vibrato rate. 5-6 normal |
| `vibrato_depth` | 0 – 100 cent | next note | Vibrato depth (cents up and down). 0 none; 10-20 normal; 40+ exaggerated |
| `vibrato_delay` | 0 – 4 s | next note | Delay after note start before vibrato begins |
| `tone` | 500 – 20000 Hz | ✓ | Final low-pass: brightness |
| `pressure` | 0 – 1 | ✓ | Bow pressure: low = gentle and breathy; high = dense and grainy |
| `players` | 1 – 4 (integer) | — | Number of players per note: 1 solo; 3-4 ensemble |

Automation column: ✓ = notes already sounding follow immediately; next note = affects only notes that start afterward; — = cannot be automated. See [automation.md](../automation.md).

### Tuning examples

- Lyrical cello with a slow attack and deep vibrato

  ```json
  { "instrument": "strings.cello", "instrument_params": {"attack": 0.4, "vibrato_depth": 25, "vibrato_delay": 0.3, "release": 1.0} }
  ```

- Small string section (2 players)

  ```json
  { "instrument": "strings.ensemble", "instrument_params": {"players": 2} }
  ```


## Tips and common mistakes

- Bowed instruments have an attack phase, and a `length` that is too short (< 0.25 beat) sounds weak; for short notes use the `*_pizz` plucked versions.
- Multi-part strings: violin (melody) + viola (inner voice) + cello (bass) on three tracks gives more layering than a single `strings.ensemble`.
- A little `reverb` (mix 0.25-0.35, decay around 2s) sounds more like a concert hall.
